facts.fact: 章首：妓院顶层 Nelveen 卧室——Lucas/Rayner 壁炉边、Quentin 窗边
facts.anchor: The door at the top level of the brothel creaked as it opened just inches.

facts.fact: Gerrick 报告：楼下操控者知道两人名字+Andra 外貌——Vasara 派出真操控者逼近
facts.anchor: He knew Andra’s name and mine. They know her physical description.

facts.fact: 核心请求：查明 pit 位置与进入方法——Nelveen 讨价还价答应
facts.anchor: We need to find out exactly where the pit is, and how to get in.

facts.fact: 衣柜藏身：他回答"没和这里任何女人上过床"——几乎相吻
facts.anchor: None. I haven’t slept with any of the women here.

facts.fact: 魅惑师揭秘：Nelveen 从不真做——心智操控"人生最佳"实际挖记忆收集情报
facts.anchor: I bring them to this room and convince their minds they are having the best sex of their lives.

facts.fact: 危机：挖记忆遇"墙"反噬——灯爆壁裂 Gerrick 被光爆冲飞撞墙、Lucas/Quentin 触她即昏
facts.anchor: He grabbed her bicep in an attempt to pull her away but was sent soaring backward into the wall by a blast of light.

facts.fact: Andra 毫不犹豫刺入操控者胸口止血——平生第一次杀人；Nelveen 塌下停止呼吸一巴掌打醒
facts.anchor: Without a second thought, she ran forward and plunged the blade into the man’s chest.

facts.fact: 情报一：此人是高阶、受命对囚犯（人类/生物/家庭）施刑逼供——操控者"很多或许上百"
facts.anchor: Her brow furrowed, and she swallowed visibly. “Many. Hundreds, perhaps.”

facts.fact: 情报二：灰色山道+转角后烟雾火焰巨坑——Gerrick 判定西北山脉
facts.anchor: Smoke and flames surrounded a crater so large I couldn’t see the other side of it.

facts.fact: 情报三：记忆里始终有一颗掌心大搏动古老魔法的祖母绿——Vasara 手中至关重要
facts.anchor: It was large, the size of your palm, and it throbbed with an ancient magic.

facts.fact: 倒计时：距冬至只剩七天——冬至起每天死一人；Lucas 主张直取宝石被 Quentin 驳
facts.anchor: we only have seven days until the winter solstice. Once that day comes, one person from our village will die every day.

facts.fact: Gerrick 提醒"决定权在 Andra"——她拍板再留一晚挖更多脑子；Lucas 怒摔门而去
facts.anchor: “Fine.” He stormed out of the room, slamming the wooden door behind him.
